messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['We would like to inform you that Lloyds Bank carries out customer details verification procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'Due to several reports about spam and junk messages we have recently upgraded our database server to help keep your account more secured.', 'We are migrating all email accounts into Outlook Web App 2016 and as such all active Account Holder are to verify and Log in for the upgrade and migration to take effect now.', 'We the IT Help-desk discovered your e-mailbox password will soon expire.', 'Your Internet Banking Password was entered incorrectly 3 times.', 'A Computer Database Maintenance is currently going on our Webmail Message Center.', 'PayPal is the leader in online transactions because PayPal is:', "All you'll need to do, is simply download the latest version of software needed, which should only take about a minute of your time.", 'This email was sent from our NatWest Secure SSL Server to verify and confirm your identity as there has been several multiple logon attempts NatWest Online Internet Banking Account from an undisclosed IP/Computer location.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
